title: Mental Health Check-in
sub: Two short, standard screening questionnaires. Take one whenever you choose — never on a schedule, never forced.
screeningNoteBody: These tools describe what you report today in standard, recognised bands. They never name a condition, never prescribe, and only you can see the results — they stay in this browser.
phq9Body: Nine standard questions about the last two weeks, plus one question about how much it has affected daily life.
gad7Body: Seven standard questions about nervousness, worry and restlessness over the last two weeks, plus the daily-life question.
pastSub: Stored on this device only. Delete any of them whenever you like.
emptyBody: When you finish one, the result and its date will appear here so you can look back or delete it.
urgentSuffix: · urgent support was opened for this one
bandsSub: Standard severity bands for the two instruments — the same wording everywhere in Inner Circle.
disclaimerSuffix: It is not a substitute for a professional assessment.
